name: MUD World Example
description: Compact 8-cell spatial world (6 overworld cells + 2 interior tavern sub-grid cells) for the MUD World Engine cantrip. Import inactive and link via lorebook_reads.

entries.name: overworld:a1
entries.content: {"id":"overworld:a1","map":"overworld","x":0,"y":0,"name":"Village Square","desc":{"day":"Cobblestone plaza around a mossy dry fountain. Carts creak past the Rusty Lantern tavern.","night":"Iron lanterns sway in the mist; shutters are barred save for the warm glow of the tavern door."},"exits":{"E":"overworld:b1","S":"overworld:a2","IN":"tavern_f1:a1"},"objects":{"fountain":"Dry stone basin with weathered runes.","notice_board":"Pinned with faded bounty notices."},"npcs":{"bren":{"name":"Bren","role":"Watchman","desc":"Leans on a halberd, watching the square."}},"images":{"day":"","night":""}}

entries.name: overworld:b1
entries.content: {"id":"overworld:b1","map":"overworld","x":1,"y":0,"name":"Market Crossroad","desc":{"day":"Canvas stalls crowd the crossroads, smelling of roasted chestnuts, leather, and river reeds.","night":"Empty wooden frames cast skeletal shadows under a pale moon; stray cats prowl the cobbles."},"exits":{"W":"overworld:a1","E":"overworld:c1","S":"overworld:b2"},"objects":{"milestone":"Chipped obelisk marking leagues to the capital.","spice_cart":"Locked oak wagon draped in tarp."},"npcs":{"mira":{"name":"Mira","role":"Tinker","desc":"Polishes brass compasses on a velvet cloth."}},"images":{"day":"","night":""}}

entries.name: overworld:c1
entries.content: {"id":"overworld:c1","map":"overworld","x":2,"y":0,"name":"Old Bridge","desc":{"day":"An arched stone span over rushing grey water. Moss clings to the parapets.","night":"Dark water churns below the arch; fog curls around the bridge posts."},"exits":{"W":"overworld:b1","S":"overworld:c2"},"objects":{"toll_booth":"Boarded timber hut with a rusted lockbox.","lantern_post":"Bent iron post swaying over the river."},"npcs":{},"images":{"day":"","night":""}}

entries.name: overworld:a2
entries.content: {"id":"overworld:a2","map":"overworld","x":0,"y":1,"name":"Whispering Woods","desc":{"day":"Tall pines filter the sun into green shafts; needles muffle every footstep.","night":"Pitch-black boughs creak overhead while pale moths drift between the trunks."},"exits":{"N":"overworld:a1","E":"overworld:b2"},"objects":{"hollow_oak":"Ancient split trunk stuffed with dry leaves.","waystone":"Tilted granite marker half-buried in fern."},"npcs":{},"images":{"day":"","night":""}}

entries.name: overworld:b2
entries.content: {"id":"overworld:b2","map":"overworld","x":1,"y":1,"name":"Watchtower Ruins","desc":{"day":"Collapsed limestone walls on a windy ridge overlooking the valley and woods.","night":"Starlight spills through the roofless tower; cold wind whistles through arrow slits."},"exits":{"N":"overworld:b1","W":"overworld:a2","E":"overworld:c2"},"objects":{"firepit":"Ring of blackened stones with cold ash.","spiral_stair":"Broken steps leading nowhere."},"npcs":{"vesper":{"name":"Vesper","role":"Scout","desc":"Cloaked figure scanning the ridge with a spyglass."}},"images":{"day":"","night":""}}

entries.name: overworld:c2
entries.content: {"id":"overworld:c2","map":"overworld","x":2,"y":1,"name":"Sunken Monolith","desc":{"day":"A marshy clearing where a basalt pillar leans out of still, amber-tinted water.","night":"Faint blue veins pulse along the wet basalt beneath a mirror-still pool."},"exits":{"N":"overworld:c1","W":"overworld:b2"},"objects":{"monolith":"Carved basalt obelisk warm to the touch.","reed_skiff":"Half-submerged wooden punt tied to a stump."},"npcs":{},"images":{"day":"","night":""}}

entries.name: tavern_f1:a1
entries.content: {"id":"tavern_f1:a1","map":"tavern_f1","x":0,"y":0,"name":"The Rusty Lantern Taproom","desc":{"day":"Low-beamed common room smelling of hearth smoke, spilled ale, and wet wool.","night":"Crowded hearthside benches, clinking tankards, and a fiddle tune from the corner."},"exits":{"OUT":"overworld:a1","E":"tavern_f1:a2"},"objects":{"oak_bar":"Scarred counter lined with pewter mugs.","hearth":"Crackling stone fireplace."},"npcs":{"garrett":{"name":"Garrett","role":"Innkeeper","desc":"Wipes glasses behind the oak bar with one keen eye on the door."}},"images":{"day":"","night":""}}

entries.name: tavern_f1:a2
entries.content: {"id":"tavern_f1:a2","map":"tavern_f1","x":1,"y":0,"name":"Tavern Back Cellar","desc":{"day":"Cool stone vault stacked with cider casks, pickled jars, and tallow candles.","night":"Damp air and deep shadows between the barrels; floorboards creak overhead."},"exits":{"W":"tavern_f1:a1"},"objects":{"cider_cask":"Iron-hooped barrel with a brass spigot.","loose_flagstone":"Slightly raised stone near the north wall."},"npcs":{},"images":{"day":"","night":""}}
